Definition: from G3844 and G1533; to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce simultaneously:--give.
BiblicalUsage: Pareisphero means to bring in alongside, to add, to contribute. It appears once, in 2 Peter 1:5, where believers are told, beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, and to virtue knowledge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe faith is not left alone in Peter's list, it is added to, virtue beside faith and knowledge beside virtue, and diligence is the hand that does the adding.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
